rows: The Home Office published this Official Statistics release on 9 April 2026 for England and Wales, covering police custody, pre-charge bail, release under investigation and voluntary attendance for the year ending 31 March 2025.

Custody statistics are Official Statistics in Development and cover detentions, demographics, vulnerability, appropriate adults, overnight child detention, strip searches, anti-rip suits, over-24-hour detention and intimate searches.

There were 938,050 custody detentions, including 58,568 child detentions; 64,130 strip searches, 22 intimate searches and a 12% comparable-force increase in over-24-hour detentions released without charge.

The custody collection included 42 of 43 forces for detentions and 37 for strip searches, but inconsistent recording and extraction difficulties mean the data are Official Statistics in Development and should be treated with caution.
